== Acquisition ==
* Each Incense from [[Renown Heart]] vendors can only be purchased 1 time per account per day.
* You can buy an unlimited number using [[Trade Contract]]s or [[Elegy Mosaic]]s from [[Primeval Steward]] at the [[Tomb of the Primeval Kings]] in Desert Highlands.
* Exchanging [[Crystalline Ingot]]s is limited to 5 per day.

== Notes ==
* A fast way to acquire many Funerary Incense is to join a legendary [[bounty]] train and collect [[Elegy Mosaic]]s to exchange for Funerary Incense at the [[Primeval Steward]].
* Another way is to leave characters at the [[Sanctum of Nabkha]] end chests and the chests inside [[Tomb of the Primeval Kings]], as these all reward [[Trade Contracts]] which can be earned slowly, but easily by logging in to the characters each day.
